entries.german: befiehlt Ulrich v. Rosenberg, die dem Johann d. jüng. v. Sobětic entzogene Hälfte des Gutes Moldautein diesem Anhänger des Kaisers zurückzustellen. De mandato d. i. Caspar Slick ─ o. R
entries.english: He orders Ulrich von Rosenberg to restore to Johann the Younger of Sobětice the half of the estate of Moldautein that had been taken from him, since he is a supporter of the Emperor. By mandate of the imperial secretary Caspar Slick. — no reverse.
